authorize_hint: Answer "apply" to authorise this change; any other answer leaves it as it is.

loop.proposal: Look at why this session repeats itself and stop the loop.
loop.undo: Nothing to undo: the session is only looked at.

empty-wakes.proposal: Make the watcher of this session wake it less often, or only when there is work.

role-model.proposal: Run this session on the cheaper model its role calls for.
role-model.undo: Set the session back to its previous model.

expensive-subagents.proposal: Turn on agent-model-gate, so subagents need an explicit cheaper model or a reason.
expensive-subagents.undo: Set agent-model-gate enabled back to false.

advisor-excess.proposal: Turn on agent-model-gate, which caps advisor calls per day.
advisor-excess.undo: Set agent-model-gate enabled back to false.

large-context.proposal: Compact or restart this session: it keeps a large context for many calls.

idle-rewrite.proposal: Keep this session busy or let it end: each wake-up after a long pause rewrites its cache.

pace.proposal: Look at why usage here is far above its own normal pace.
pace.undo: Nothing to undo: the scope is only looked at.

expensive-automation.proposal: Run this session, which mostly answers automatic notices, on the cheaper model.
expensive-automation.undo: Set the session back to its previous model.

loop-group.proposal: Look at why the automatic sessions of this project repeat themselves and stop the loop at its source.
loop-group.undo: Nothing to undo: the sessions are only looked at.

empty-wakes-group.proposal: Make the watchers of this project wake their sessions less often, or only when there is work.

role-model-group.proposal: Run this project's automatic sessions of that role on the cheaper model.
role-model-group.undo: Set those sessions back to their previous model.

large-context-group.proposal: Compact or restart the sessions of this project that keep a large context for many calls.

idle-rewrite-group.proposal: Keep the sessions of this project busy or let them end: each wake-up after a long pause rewrites the cache.

expensive-automation-group.proposal: Run this project's sessions that mostly answer automatic notices on the cheaper model.
expensive-automation-group.undo: Set those sessions back to their previous model.
